name: Beijing SOJO Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing SOJO Electric Co., Ltd. engages in the research, production, export, and sale of power distribution, electrical, and automation equipment in the field of power transmission and distribution networks in China and internationally. It offers medium voltage switchgears, including solid insulated switchgears/RMU, SF6 insulated switchgears, air insulated switchgears, and air insulated compact switchgears, primary solid switchgears; gas and air insulated switchgears; outdoor medium voltage vacuum circuit breakers, outdoor pole mounted circuit breakers, and outdoor load break switches; and switchgear components.
